title: Gestalt: a meta-foundation model for astronomy
abstract: arXiv:2609.38312v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis predicts that sufficiently scaled foundation models converge on a shared representation of the world. As each non-converged model gives a noisy view of a common structure when passed the same input, we ask whether we can combine models into a representation that outperforms its individual components. We test this on galaxies: we embed images via a basket of 22 frozen foundation models from eight families, whiten each view, and take a randomised SVD of the embedding concatenation. The resulting 1024-dimensional embedding outperforms every basket member on 19/21 of our tested metrics for physical property and galaxy morphology estimation for HSC, JWST, and DESI Legacy Survey imagery. We find that performance rises with basket size and basket architectural diversity, and that the meta-foundation model's performance transfers across astronomical surveys. translated_title: Gestalt：一个面向天文学的元基础模型
translated_abstract: 柏拉图表示假说预测，规模足够大的基础模型将收敛于对世界的共同表示。由于每个尚未收敛的模型在接收相同输入时，只能给出对这一共同结构的带噪声视图，我们提出一个问题：能否将多个模型组合成一个优于其各个组成部分的表示？我们在星系上对此进行了检验：我们利用来自八个家族的22个冻结基础模型对图像进行嵌入，对每个视图进行白化处理，然后对拼接后的嵌入做随机奇异值分解（SVD）。由此得到的1024维嵌入，在针对HSC、JWST和DESI Legacy Survey图像的物理属性与星系形态估计的21项测试指标中的19项上，均优于篮中的每一个模型。我们发现，性能随篮中模型数量和架构多样性的增加而提升，且该元基础模型的性能可以在不同天文巡天之间迁移。我们得出的结论是，一个有用的天文学基础模型……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 研究者将来自8个家族的22个冻结基础模型的星系图像嵌入经白化与随机SVD融合，构建出元基础模型Gestalt，其1024维嵌入在21项指标中的19项上超越所有单个模型，且性能随模型数量与架构多样性提升并能跨天文巡天迁移。
en_tdlr: The authors fuse embeddings from 22 frozen foundation models across 8 families via whitening and randomized SVD to create Gestalt, a meta-foundation model whose 1024-dimensional galaxy embeddings outperform every individual model on 19/21 metrics and transfer across astronomical surveys.
